policy_notes: Explicit line-wide directional delays may apply despite an initiating fault outside the ridden section.
Opposite-direction notices are excluded; later direction expansions are never backdated.
Routine bridge openings with unspecified planning status and unspecified maintenance/work-train movement remain unresolved.
Partial reroutes or short-turns are ordinary service disruptions unless explicit severe-delay or full-closure wording applies.
This is input-only qualification. The producer must still verify each notice belongs to the latest valid active capture at the historical cutoff.
Far Rockaway-bound-only clauses are unresolved when the exact historical terminal branch cannot be established from preserved input metadata; a southbound platform direction alone is insufficient.
